review_evidence: README identifies GinacLean as a work-in-progress Lean 4 FFI binding to the GiNaC symbolic algebra library.

The library defines opaque FFI-backed symbolic types and operations; the example exercises those interfaces, and the codegen fixture contains a distinct mock formal interface used to test binding generation.
The lakefile itself contains substantial Lean definitions for build/link discovery and job construction, so neither build nor fixture paths satisfy a lossless no-formal-content invariant.
summary: Retain GinacLean's library, example, code-generation fixture, and build DSL source because each contains Lean definitions or formal interfaces.
